title: Merry Monograms & Watercolour Florals
description: Register Here! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. Sunday, November 23, 2025 1:00 – 4:00 pm | Ages 16+ Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio A 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Get ready to make this season a little more creative—and a lot more magical! In this holiday themed workshop, you’ll learn how to design watercolor monograms surrounded by festive blooms and accented with shimmering touches of gold. No prior experience is needed—just a love for creativity! You’ll work with vibrant watercolors, metallic paints and pencils to create one-of-a kind gift tags, cards, and keepsakes. This workshop is a perfect way to learn new artistic skills, get into the festive spirit, and make lasting holiday memories. Bring your friends and let’s make it a festive afternoon! A $15 material fee is payable in cash to the instructor on the day of the workshop.
